test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 10 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Articles 124 and 217 of the Constitution of India deal with which of the following?

options.text: The appointment of the UPSC Chairman
The appointment of the Chief Minister

solution:
The correct answer is __**The appointment of judges.**__ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Articles 124 and 217 **of the Constitution deal with the appointment of judges to the Supreme Court and high courts.
 
• **Article 124** states that there shall be a Supreme Court of India consisting of a Chief Justice of India and such number of other judges not being less than seven as Parliament may by law prescribe.
 
• **Article 217 - **Appointment and conditions of the office of a judge of a High Court
 
• Every Judge of a High Court shall be appointed by the President by warrant under his hand and seal after consultation with the Chief Justice of India, the Governor of the State, and, in the case of appointment of a Judge other than the Chief Justice, the Chief Justice of the High Court, and 1 shall hold office, in the case of an additional or acting Judge, as provided in article 224, and in any other case, until he attains the age of **sixty-two years.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** 

 
• **Appointment of Governor:**

 
 
• The Governor of a State shall be appointed by the President by warrant under his hand and seal **(Article 155)**. 
 
 
 
• **Appointment of the UPSC Chairman:**
 
 
• **Article-316**. Appointment and term of office of members.
 
• The Chairman and other members of a Public Service Commission shall be appointed, in the case of the Union Commission or a Joint Commission, by the President, and in the case of a State Commission, by the Governor of the State.
